findings.description: The monotonic sequence high-water mark table (work_queue_projection_heads) combined with change-scoped advisory locking completely eliminates the stale submit race condition across different sequence numbers during concurrent submit/reconcile operations.
findings.resolution: Preserve the high-water check and advisory lock ordering during implementation.

findings.description: Reconciliation endpoint authorization is explicitly mapped to the existing submit_work policy action with mode=reconcile context, preserving existing Cedar policy boundaries while enforcing strict RFC 7807 401/403 problem responses on denial.
findings.resolution: Maintain submit_work policy mapping and RFC 7807 failure envelopes during API implementation.

findings.description: Verification commands for wp-coordinator-queue explicitly include dedicated direct MCP projection test modules (test_mcp_work_projection.py) alongside API, CLI, and PostgreSQL integration suites to guarantee transport parity.
findings.resolution: Ensure test_mcp_work_projection.py is implemented and executed as part of package and integration verification gates.

findings.description: Migration 035 implements deterministic preflight validation under SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE table locks, aborting with documented SQLSTATE errors for legacy malformed or duplicate rows to ensure clean rollback and safe retries.
findings.resolution: Keep preflight SQLSTATE checks and transactional rollback intact during migration file creation.

findings.description: The autopilot state machine enforces a persist-first ordering seam where loop-state persistence precedes queue projection, and resume reconciliation reconstructs queue state strictly from loaded loop-state without mutating authoritative state.
findings.resolution: Retain the one-way authority invariant and post-persistence projection callback structure in autopilot scripts.

findings.description: The work-package DAG and write scope boundaries cleanly segregate contracts, coordinator persistence, bridge outbox seams, and integration validation without overlapping write permissions or circular dependencies.
findings.resolution: Maintain work package isolation and scope write_allow lists during task execution.
